responsibility: Implements the low-level translation layer from Cell SPU-style intrinsics to equivalent PPU/VMX operations. It defines qword-based scalar/vector conversion helpers and a large body of inline functions and macros that emulate SPU arithmetic, logical, shuffle, constant-formation, and memory-access primitives using AltiVec/VMX types and builtins, serving as the foundational compatibility layer that higher-level spu2vmx.h wrappers build upon.
